text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after receiving 
the gift from Phalaenopsis.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The lecture I was invited to give went off 
without a hitch. 
I was nervous, but I'd like to think... I 
gave a talk 
worthy of Phalaenopsis's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Well done. 
Now, let us off to our celebration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis strides ahead with effortless 
grace. 
Following behind her, I make my way 
to our second celebration...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After transferring between trains, 
we arrived at a hot spring town.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to a tourist town, numerous 
traditional sweet shops 
had their banners fluttering, drawing 
customers in.
choice_data_list:
Which shop are we going to? They all look 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hm? 
No, not here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: It is further ahead. Come.

text_block_list.name: Proprietor
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome. We have been expecting you. 
Please, relax and enjoy your time to your 
heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, while it is still hot. 
Freshly steamed manju is truly 
exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place exudes history. The matcha and 
manju, 
served in tableware of unmistakably 
superior caliber, 
leave me sitting stiffly in formal seiza, 
unable to relax.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hehe, whatever has you so intimidated?
choice_data_list:
I just didn't expect such an extravagant 
place...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I merely arranged a venue worthy of a 
celebration.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...At the very least, 
I deemed the refinement here fitting for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Now, go on and enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reach for the manju brought before me. 
Taking a bite, steaming, sweet bean paste 
spills out 
from inside the delicate, thin crust.
choice_data_list:
...! You're right, fresh from the steamer, 
it's incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It pairs wonderfully with the matcha. 
It seems 'freshly steamed is exceptional' 
was no exaggeration.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forgive me. 
Pay it no mind.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Is it good?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see. 
That is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good. That is good. 
...Stay well and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Only when you are well can I move forward. 
So please, continue to care for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —My beloved disciple.
